name: codex-pulse
description: Quota-aware guidance for ordinary Codex chats, backed by the user's local Codex Pulse monitor.

interface.shortDescription: Use Codex quota on the work that matters.
interface.longDescription: Adds local, quota-aware guidance and selectable finish-current, strict-reserve, or deadline policies to ordinary Codex chats. It never uploads prompts, auto-approves permissions, or redeems reset credits.
defaultPrompt: Show my current Codex Pulse recommendation.
Help me decide whether to start a large Codex task now.
